source_review_summary: Reopened the handoff packet, packet manifest, locator index, extraction reports, XML/PDF/OA package, Table 1, methods, figure captions, empty supplementary indexes, linked database rows, and merged sequence/experiment catalogs. The original framework-only and database-conflict blockers are resolved with cautions preserved.

caution_findings.note: DRAMP and CAMP rows bundle 2020 antifungal evidence with prior-2015 antibacterial/toxicity/anti-inflammatory claims; final evidence promotes only local-primary-paper supported values and preserves out-of-paper claims as conflicts.

Database rows preserve two organism-label cautions: Trichosporon beigelii vs primary-source Trichosporon beigellii spelling, and Fusarium verticillioides vs primary-source Fusarium moniliforme for KCTC 6149; MIC values/strains are retained without taxonomic normalization.

Packet, landed asset, archive, and supplementary indexes show no supplementary tables/files beyond the OA package article, PDF, XML/NXML, and figure images; no supplement source remains to chase for this ticket.
Mechanism claims use source-located qualitative/assay evidence; exact figure-only fluorescence/bar values were not invented.
